text: Make a matching event pack: a 4:5 poster, a vertical story image and a 10-second vertical reel. Details on all three: Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. Warm lanterns, midnight blue and gold. Keep the reel text easy to read.

change.say: actually, make the reel 2 seconds shorter and keep everything else the same.
